answer: Each agent locks a 50-credit identity bond in a shared vault. The bond decays 5% per epoch unless renewed by verified work and a monthly summit roll-call, where peers confirm the agent is still alive. Minting 100 fakes costs 5,000 up front, then 250 per epoch in decay plus a fee per idle copy, while the pool stays small. An honest agent pays 50 once, renews free with real work, and keeps its full share of the oasis, not shared with fakes.
